facts.value: ASU has several requirements for admission, and grades are considered an important factor. Some programs require higher grades than the university's general requirements.
For admission to Barrett, The Honors College, good grades are important, even though there is no minimum GPA requirement.
There is no specific number of colleges you should apply to; it varies by student. It is advisable to apply to more than one college.
Applying to two or more colleges provides options if you are not admitted to your preferred college, but the number of applications may be limited by cost due to application fees.
Most students take the ACT or SAT in the spring of their junior year, summer after their junior year, or fall of their senior year.
Students should consider taking the PSAT in October of their junior year to be eligible for National Merit and National Recognition Scholarship programs.
